sloka: विकुक्षेस्तु महातेजा बाण: पुत्र: प्रतापवान् ।बाणस्य तु महाबाहुरनरण्यो महायशा: ॥ २.११०.९॥
transliteration: vikukṣestu mahātejā bāṇa: putra: pratāpavān ।bāṇasya tu mahābāhuranaraṇyo mahāyaśā: ॥ 2.110.9॥

translations.english: The son of Vikukshi was highly energetic and powerful Bana and to him was born the mightyarmed Anaranya of great renown.
